plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Criminal Justice, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 2101R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/social-science-and-communication-department/criminal-justice/criminal-justice-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four 'Fall/Spring Semester Freshman/Sophomore Year' tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals). TRUE award: Associate of Arts. Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester totals 15/16/14/15 sum exactly. Choice slots: HUMA GE / MATH GE / HUMA GE2 / SCIG GE / COMM GE / WELL GE / SCIG GE2 are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice); ELEC ANY is 'College Level Electives' (2 credits, student choice). Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page. Footnotes: Humanities and Science courses must each be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
